description:
Please note this property requires full refurbishment throughout. Offered with no onward chain, having great sized living accommodation and being in an ideal location close to amenities, this property is perfect for investors looking for a new project. Having been successfully let, the property is an ideal buy to let subject to works being carried out. The accommodation is entered via vestibule which opens into a great sized reception room. There is further access to an inner hallway, dining room and archway to a kitchen. To the first floor is a landing area, two bedrooms and bathroom. Externally the property overlooks a local green area to the front and is within close proximity to local shops and amenities. There is also an enclosed yard to the rear.

BEDROOM TWO Good sized single room with window to rear.

BATHROOM Window to rear, partially tiled and fitted with suite.

EXTERNALLY Externally the property overlooks a local green area to the front and is within close proximity to local shops and amenities. There is also an enclosed yard to the rear.
